Strong earthquake sequence strikes off northern Vanuatu after initial M6.9 event
items.summary: An M6.9 earthquake struck off northern Vanuatu at 13:31 LT (02:31 UTC) on October 24, 2026, followed four minutes and 29 seconds later by an M6.3 event and at least eight additional M5+ earthquakes in the USGS catalog through 05:23 UTC.The Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said the tsunami threat had passed at 03:28 UTC. No immediate damage or casualties were reported. Source

items.title: Hurricane Vance continues strengthening south of Mexico, forecast to reach Category 3
items.summary: Hurricane Vance continued strengthening far south of Mexico on October 23, 2026, with maximum sustained winds reaching 150 km/h (90 mph) at 09:00 LT (15:00 UTC). The National Hurricane Center (NHC) forecast Vance to briefly reach Category 3 intensity Saturday morning but said the intensity forecast had low confidence because cooler water and increasing wind shear could limit further strengthening. Source

items.title: M7.0 earthquake kills at least 16, injures 76 in Xizang, China
items.summary: An M7.0 earthquake struck Baqen County in China’s Xizang Autonomous Region at 22:33 LT (14:33 UTC) on October 22, 2026, killing at least 16 people and injuring 76, according to the latest Nagqu municipal assessment. Authorities said homes belonging to 339 households had collapsed or been damaged, while 12 489 residents had been relocated by 10:00 LT on October 23. Source

items.title: Eastern Pacific reaches 21 named storms for the first time since 2018 as Tropical Storm Vance strengthens
items.summary: Tropical Storm Vance strengthened over the eastern Pacific on October 22, becoming the 21st named storm of the 2026 season and making 2026 the first eastern Pacific season since 2018 to reach that total. items.title: Strong and shallow M7.0 earthquake hits Xizang-Qinghai border region, China
items.summary: A strong M7.0 earthquake registered by the USGS hit the Xizang-Qinghai border region, China, at 14:33 UTC on October 22, 2026. The USGS is reporting a depth of 18 km (11.2 miles). EMSC is reporting M7.0 at a depth of 10 km (6.2 miles). Source

items.title: France forecasts lowest grain-maize yield since 1991 after record heatwaves in summer 2026
items.summary: France’s 2026 grain-maize yield is forecast to fall to 6.3 tonnes per hectare (2.81 short tons per acre), its lowest level since 1991, after repeated heatwaves and persistent drought damaged crops. Agreste estimates production, including seed maize, at 7.3 million tonnes (8 million short tons), nearly half the 2025 level, as grain-maize area fell 28% and yield declined 27%. Source
